render_manifest_contract.note: Render manifest validator reads these allowlists. Additions are contract changes — open a PR against this registry before authoring a manifest that uses a new value.

capabilities.summary: Write the script-first authoring pass and the minimum narration source needed for audio generation.
verification: script is coherent and on-brief before VO generation
any narration source prepared for audio stays aligned to the script
capabilities.fallback_or_block: If the brief is thin, tighten task-config before dispatch.

capabilities.summary: Author the board canvas from script, brief, and channel identity before audio timing exists.
verification: board index and scene boards agree on one film spine
board scene flow interprets the script without timing math
capabilities.fallback_or_block: If the brief is too thin to choose a script interpretation or channel variation, stop and tighten the brief before authoring the board.

capabilities.summary: Verify facts, source rights-clear media, and land research outputs on disk.
outputs: project-owned downloaded assets under research/media/ or images/refs/
verification: findings propagated into authored package when needed
capabilities.fallback_or_block: If rights are unclear or access is blocked, return BLOCKED explicitly instead of a fake completion.

capabilities.summary: Cold-read the authored package and route real weaknesses before build.
outputs: reviewer findings shaped for remediation lanes
capabilities.fallback_or_block: If package artifacts are missing, do not infer them from code; send work back to authoring.

capabilities.summary: Review rendered output and isolate root cause across render, timing, media, code, and authored package.
capabilities.fallback_or_block: If signals cannot run, state the diagnostic downgrade explicitly instead of silently skipping to vision.

capabilities.summary: Stitch beats, wire VO to visuals, own timing lock usage, and compose the film on the approved runtime timeline after package approval.
requires: timing lock artifacts when VO exists
specialist outputs where the approved board, render manifest, or spec calls for them
outputs: chapter or film runtime composition updates
capabilities.fallback_or_block: Dispatch bounded execution to the owning specialist lane; keep thread-holding composition decisions in the editor when timing and beat ownership are coupled.

capabilities.summary: Generate voiceover audio, produce words.json, and refresh timing lock for downstream manifest derivation.
capabilities.fallback_or_block: Missing voiceover source or output path is a hard stop.

capabilities.summary: Generate score, SFX, and final mix for the film.
outputs: not live in current production mode
capabilities.fallback_or_block: Keep scope to voiceover plus timing lock until score/SFX/mix is explicitly reactivated.

capabilities.summary: Generate or wire image assets into editor-marked visual slots and record a media manifest.
intents: wire image assets to approved render slots
requires: image prompts or archival asset paths
outputs: asset path bindings for approved render slots
verification: asset matches prompt or archival subject
media index row written or updated
slot binding checked when a render-manifest path is provided
capabilities.fallback_or_block: If bounded beat/slot ownership, prompt, output directory, or reusable media inventory is missing, stop instead of inventing coverage.

capabilities.summary: Generate motion video beats for editor-marked visual slots.
outputs: pending until video generation doc is wired
verification: must be flagged as pending rather than presented as available
capabilities.fallback_or_block: Handle image beats only and mark video beats as pending until tools/video-gen.md stops being a stub.

capabilities.summary: Select or build runtime motion graphics and data-viz components for specific beats.
requires: approved composition path or render-manifest cut
requested beat or bounded beat range
outputs: HyperFrames composition code or variable updates for the requested beats
authority_inputs: primitive/sprite design pack and shared composition library
capabilities.fallback_or_block: Thin visual direction, missing timing, or chapter-owned scope is a hard stop; do not invent the frame.

capabilities.summary: Build map scenes from locked geographic specs using projection math and channel values.
requires: map spec with bounds, labels, routes, and timing
storyboard cut ID and binding target
requested beat or bounded map slot ownership
outputs: manifest-ready map composition binding for the requested beat
shared geo data or composition updates when required
capabilities.fallback_or_block: Missing bounds, camera keyframes, labels, or timing is a hard stop.

capabilities.summary: Use Google Workspace apps directly through the thin gws adapter for Docs, Drive, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar, or Chat workflows.
requires: object IDs or URLs for the requested app surface
outputs: app-native Workspace change or read result with provenance references
verification: explicit degraded-mode report when auth or scopes are missing
capabilities.fallback_or_block: If gws auth or scopes are missing, report degraded mode explicitly; do not build a local Workspace abstraction as a workaround.
